name: NGC 2970 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2970, a nearby early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2970-hubble
story: A small nearby galaxy with a dense cluster of stars packed into its very center. Faint spiral structure hints that it may have been shaped by a merger.

claims.text: NGC 2970 is one of the nearby field early-type galaxies in the AMUSE-Field sample
NGC 2970 has a nuclear star cluster
NGC 2970 has faint spiral structure, perhaps from a merger
The Hubble data are ACS F475W/F850LP snapshots at the galaxy's position
